CREATE VIEW all_people ( id string, first_name string, last_name string, source_db string ) AS SELECT CONCAT('mysql_student_', CAST(s_id AS string)) as id, first_name, last_name, 'mysql_student' as source_db FROM uni1.student
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('mysql_academic_', CAST(a_id AS string)) as id, first_name, last_name, 'mysql_academic' as source_db FROM uni1.academic
UNION ALL
SELECT CONCAT('pgsql_person_', CAST(pid AS string)) as id, fname as first_name, lname as last_name, 'postgresql_person' as source_db FROM uni2.person
UNION ALL
SELECT _id as id, first_name, last_name, 'mongodb_person' as source_db FROM mongo_people.person;
